# simplex-noise 4.0.3

Unmodified ES module from the published `simplex-noise@4.0.3` package:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simplex-noise@4.0.3/dist/esm/simplex-noise.js

Upstream: https://github.com/jwagner/simplex-noise.js

License: MIT; see `LICENSE` and the copyright notice in the source.
Only `createNoise2D` is used. Each field receives a separate seeded PRNG from
`biome-world.js`; there are no runtime downloads or Node/browser dependencies.
